description: This PHP class 'ContentPage' extends a base ContentPage class to generate Confluence-formatted pages, embed images, handle attachments, and convert details tags within content.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: A class responsible for generating Confluence-formatted content pages with embedded images and specific header handling.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Generates the Confluence content page, embeds images, converts details tags, and adds optional header macros.

methods.name: createImageTag
methods.description: Creates an HTML image tag in Confluence format for a given filename and attributes.
